title: Evo 2 in-context learning generates regulatory DNA enhancers from few examples
summary: Prompting the genome language model Evo 2 with tens of examples conditioned it to generate novel, diverse regulatory DNA without additional training, and reinforcement learning with sequence-to-function rewards was also used. Designed enhancers drove cell-type-specific expression in three human cell lines, and in mouse cortex they selectively labelled layer 5 ET neurons with higher activity than existing enhancers. Preprint known from its abstract only, which gives no numbers.
